company.name: Experiential Labs
company.shortDescription: Experiential Labs trains and serves AI models for agents using production traces and workflow simulations.
company.description: Experiential Labs provides model endpoints for AI agents and trains smaller models using production traces. Its system converts logged agent activity into simulations of company tasks, constraints, and edge cases. The company uses these simulations to train and evaluate models against operational workflows. Its service includes continuous retraining, model routing, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, distillation, and token compression. Experiential Labs offers an OpenAI-compatible API and supports connections to sources such as Arize, Braintrust, LangChain, and customer databases. The company also develops the open-source World Model Optimizer for evaluating agent behavior in simulated environments.
